notes: The first link «أبي ره» is the compiler's own father, written with no name: a bare relation
«شيخ كان عندنا» is an unnamed transmitter, a gap the text does not fill
«سمعت أبا عبد الله ع يقول» makes the Imam the last link (Imami owner ruling 2); the honorific is not part of the surface
«[أَنْ] أصله [أَصِلَ]» is an editor's bracketed correction of the wording and is left out
